comment: Unify Native Auth V2 sign-in and sign-up password collection with PasswordRequiredStateV2 and the isPasswordRequired result guard. Remove the separate SignUpPasswordRequiredStateV2 export, inline the single-use sign-up attributes state base, and separate password submission by scenario while preserving error handling and sign-in MFA. Support repeated sign-up attribute/password collection and replace post-submission verification with collection, enrollment, or explicit sign-in continuation.
